turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Why does my son have a zero?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Thank you. Now, why does Owen have a zero, and who decided that before anyone called me?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, Hale?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.
"Quite reliable" isn't a document, Hale. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software results don't establish a concern by themselves. I'll ask again: what else do you have?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Under 4.2 you were required to call me before any mark went in, and nobody did. So you decided first and asked questions later. Withdraw the zero, Hale.
I hope you understand my position.
My position is the one that matters here, Hale. Owen found out from the gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class. Take the zero off, and then we can talk about what you actually have.
